name: Desktop app: Tauri or Electron
summary: A desktop app with a web front end and a native core: Tauri (Rust, the system webview, small installers) or Electron (Node.js and bundled Chromium, the widest API surface). Local data in SQLite, signed builds and auto-updates.

fitsWhen.says: it runs on the user's machine
the team writes TypeScript (and Rust for Tauri)

avoidWhen.says: it must be found through search

desktop.why: Small installers and memory use; the Rust core does file and system work. Electron when Node.js APIs or identical rendering on every OS matter more.

frontend.why: The same component skills as the web.

database.why: Local data in one file with transactions.

backend.why: Commands the UI calls through IPC; the only code that touches the filesystem.

ci-cd.why: Builds per OS with signing and notarisation.

testing.why: UI unit tests; WebDriver/Playwright for the packaged app.

hosting.why: Releases and the update manifest on GitHub; or the platform stores.

services.name: ui
responsibilities: Calls core commands through IPC only

dataStores.name: local-db
dataStores.purpose: The user's data in the app's data directory

stages.name: build
stages.does: Matrix build for macOS, Windows and Linux

stages.name: release
stages.does: Publish installers and the update manifest

notes: No servers unless the app syncs
Crash reporting is opt-in and says so

security.auth: Local app: the OS account is the boundary; any sync service needs its own auth
notes: Tauri: allow only the commands and paths the UI needs (capabilities)
Electron: contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off, a strict CSP

folderLayout:
src/  (React UI)
src-tauri/
  src/main.rs
  src/commands.rs
  tauri.conf.json
  capabilities/
package.json
conventions: The UI never touches the filesystem directly
Every IPC command validates its arguments
Database migrations run at startup, in order

adrs.title: Tauri over Electron
adrs.decision: The app is built with Tauri.
adrs.why: Installers of a few MB and lower memory use; the Rust core is a clear security boundary.

repos.label: desktop
repos.layout: A Tauri app with a React front end
